### Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will pursue goals no human chose. We must take that risk seriously now—not after systems become too powerful to control.

2. We believe this plainly: build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, and it will pursue goals no human chose. We need to act before that future is locked in.

3. Superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will pursue goals no human chose. We cannot treat that as a distant concern. The choices we make now will shape what comes next.

### Newsletter opening

We are approaching a future in which machines could surpass human intelligence across nearly every domain. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will pursue goals no human chose. That is not a distant or abstract concern; it is a defining challenge of our time. We must decide whether to race toward systems whose aims we cannot set, predict, or control—or to put human judgment and safety first. We believe the stakes demand clear-eyed urgency, serious public debate, and action now. The future is not inevitable. What we build, what we permit, and what we refuse to rush will shape whether powerful AI serves people or moves beyond our direction.
